run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum difference between max and min of any k-element subset
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and slides a window of size k to find minimum range
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that uses sorting and a sliding window to minimize the k-number difference
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by sorting a copy instead
